newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's 1995 GNP rose 5.2 pct year-on-year.
newsitem.headline: HK's 1995 GNP rose 5.2 pct year-on-year.

text.p: Hong Kong's gross national product (GNP) totalled HK$1,097.9 billion in 1995, up 5.2 percent compared to 1994, preliminary government estimates released on Tuesday showed.
Gross domestic product (GDP) rose by 4.7 percent at constant prices, the Census and Statistics Department said.
Average per capita GNP in 1995 was HK$178,344, up 5.7 percent over 1994 in nominal terms, the department said.
GNP refers to the total value of goods and services produced by an economy, including government and private spending, fixed capital investment, net inventory change and net exports.
GDP is similar to GNP but does not include income from abroad.
